title: Signal: Possible a hardcoded PayPal account password assigned to PAYPAL_PASSWORD in source
scope: One line, matching a hardcoded PayPal account password assigned to PAYPAL_PASSWORD.
limitations: Shape-only: the rule matches a credential-named key assigned a password-shaped literal (8+ characters with at least one digit). It cannot prove the value is live, current, or used by this system.
fpNotes: Documentation samples, template placeholders and generated example configurations are the common false positives; the pattern requires 8+ characters and at least one digit, and vetoes EXAMPLE text.
